[LINT.6.1] An `Interval<T>` value has these readable components:

| Component | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `i.start` | `T` | Inclusive start endpoint |
| `i.end`   | `T` | Exclusive end endpoint |
| `i.duration` | `Duration` | `i.end - i.start`, for `T` `Time` or `Date` only |

The compiler must refuse any other component, and `i.duration` on an interval
whose element type is neither `Time` nor `Date`, with
`DS_VALIDATE_BAD_INTERVAL_COMPONENT`.
